description: The native commands installed Whispering (app id so.epicenter.whispering) uses, granted to its windows by app id: every label open_installed_window makes for that id, with or without a folder. It records into the folder its window was granted (ADR-0543), transcribes with the one active local model and reads whether that model is ready (ADR-0180), and opens Settings where that model is chosen. The folder plugin comes from installed-app-windows. Approving an app trusts it fully (ADR-0540), so this is wiring, not a sandbox: it lists what the app calls, and nothing it does not.
